description:
Remove the default data classification level for a project.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:**

 *  *Administer projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.
 *  *Administer jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The project ID or project key (case-sensitive).
parameters.name: projectIdOrKey

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the user does not have the necessary permission.

404.description: Returned if the project is not found.

summary: Remove the default data classification level from a project
